outcome: Oxytocin use for augmentation of labour
cohort: The study included nulliparous women (Robson group 1) and parous women with no previous caesarean birth (Robson group 3), all with singleton, cephalic presentation births, gestational week >= 37 + 0, and spontaneous onset of labour.
finding: Substantial variations in oxytocin use for augmentation of labour persisted between obstetric units in Sweden, even after adjusting for risk factors, indicating unjustified differences in clinical practice.
